import numpy as np

def select_next_node(current_node, truck_nodes, depot_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    # Candidates: unvisited nodes not currently targeted by any truck
    mask = ~np.isin(unvisited_nodes, truck_nodes)
    candidates = unvisited_nodes[mask]
    if len(candidates) == 0:
        return None

    # Classic savings: d(depot,current) + d(depot,candidate) - d(current,candidate)
    depot_current = distance_matrix[depot_node, current_node]
    depot_cands = distance_matrix[depot_node, candidates]
    current_cands = distance_matrix[current_node, candidates]
    savings = depot_current + depot_cands - current_cands

    # Average distance from candidate to other trucks' targets
    if len(truck_nodes) > 0:
        dists_to_trucks = distance_matrix[np.ix_(candidates, truck_nodes)]
        avg_dists_to_trucks = np.mean(dists_to_trucks, axis=1)
    else:
        avg_dists_to_trucks = np.zeros(len(candidates))

    # Average distance from candidate to other unvisited nodes (excluding itself)
    n_unvisited = len(unvisited_nodes)
    if n_unvisited > 1:
        dists_to_all = distance_matrix[np.ix_(candidates, unvisited_nodes)]
        avg_dists_to_unvisited = np.sum(dists_to_all, axis=1) / (n_unvisited - 1)
    else:
        avg_dists_to_unvisited = np.zeros(len(candidates))

    # New linear combination score: savings + alpha * avg_dists_to_trucks - beta * avg_dists_to_unvisited
    alpha = 0.7
    beta = 0.3
    score = savings + alpha * avg_dists_to_trucks - beta * avg_dists_to_unvisited

    best_idx = np.argmax(score)
    next_node = candidates[best_idx]
    return next_node

import numpy as np

def select_next_node(current_node, truck_nodes, depot_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    # Identify candidate nodes not currently targeted by any truck
    mask = ~np.isin(unvisited_nodes, truck_nodes)
    candidates = unvisited_nodes[mask]
    if len(candidates) == 0:
        return None

    # Classic savings: d(depot,current) + d(depot,candidate) - d(current,candidate)
    depot_current = distance_matrix[depot_node, current_node]
    depot_cands = distance_matrix[depot_node, candidates]
    current_cands = distance_matrix[current_node, candidates]
    savings = depot_current + depot_cands - current_cands

    # Compute median distance from each candidate to all truck targets
    if len(truck_nodes) > 0:
        dists_to_trucks = distance_matrix[np.ix_(candidates, truck_nodes)]
        median_dists = np.median(dists_to_trucks, axis=1)
    else:
        median_dists = np.zeros(len(candidates))

    # Combined score with different parameter settings (lambda, median instead of mean)
    lambda_param = 0.7
    score = savings + lambda_param * median_dists

    best_idx = np.argmax(score)
    next_node = candidates[best_idx]
    return next_node
